definitions.gloss: the degree of saltiness; the amount of salt used
definitions.explanation: refers to how salty something is or the appropriate amount of salt to use in cooking

examples.japanese: {塩加減|しおかげん}を{見|み}る。
{塩加減|しおかげん}がちょうどいい。
お{味噌汁|みそしる}の{塩加減|しおかげん}を{調整|ちょうせい}する。
examples.english: Adjust the saltiness of the miso soup.

notes:
COOKING TERM:
{塩加減|しおかげん} is an essential concept in Japanese cooking. The word combines {塩|しお} (salt) + {加減|かげん} (degree/adjustment).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {塩加減|しおかげん}を{見|み}る - to taste for saltiness
- {塩加減|しおかげん}が{難|むずか}しい - saltiness is hard to get right
- {塩加減|しおかげん}を{調整|ちょうせい}する - to adjust the salt level

RELATED ～{加減|かげん} WORDS:
- {味加減|あじかげん} - seasoning (general)
- {甘|あま}さ{加減|かげん} - sweetness level
- {火加減|ひかげん} - heat level
- {湯加減|ゆかげん} - water/bath temperature

TIPS:
{塩加減|しおかげん}は{後|あと}から{足|た}せるが、{入|い}れすぎると{戻|もど}せない - "You can always add more salt, but you can't remove it if you add too much."
